name: Acker et al. 2009
license: Cited by URL; no text, figure or data is reused. NASA NTRS lists it for public distribution, with public use permitted.
citation: Acker, J. G., et al. (2009), "Time-Series Analysis of Remotely-Sensed SeaWiFS Chlorophyll in River-Influenced Coastal Regions", EARSeL eProceedings 8(2), NASA NTRS 20090042747. The worked example of the NASA Space Apps challenge. BORAMAE starts from its box-average-then-regress workflow, which survives as the OLS cross-check; verdicts use Mann–Kendall with a lag-1 Hamed–Rao correction, a Theil–Sen confidence interval and a 20-year minimum record, which the paper did not apply.
